full_sentence: Although we were tired, we played football all afternoon.
acceptable_variants: we still went out to the park.
we still had a lot of fun.

options.text: so we went to bed early.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, but 'although' needs a contrast. The two connectors do not fit together here.
This describes the weather but does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

options.text: we were sleeping at that time.
options.why_wrong: This continues the idea of tiredness instead of showing a contrasting action.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' and past simple 'was/were'
explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first part. Spanish speakers may want to use a result connector here, but English needs a contrasting action.
translation: Aunque estábamos cansados, jugamos al fútbol toda la tarde.
